payout_quote: You will receive $20 in CLUB Points, redeemable with a purchase on your new card. Earn $20 in CLUB Points after making 2 purchases on separate visits at Bass Pro Shops, Cabela's, or Mack's Prairie Wings within the first 30 days after account approval. Earn an additional $20 in CLUB Points after 5 purchases everywhere else Mastercard is accepted made within the first 30 days after account approval.
steps: Apply and be approved for the Bass Pro Shops / Cabela's CLUB Mastercard (issued by Capital One, $0 annual fee)
$20 in CLUB Points awarded on approval, redeemable with a purchase on the new card
Make 2 purchases on separate visits at Bass Pro, Cabela's, or Mack's Prairie Wings within 30 days of approval for another $20
Make 5 purchases anywhere Mastercard is accepted within 30 days of approval for another $20
Bonus points awarded within 60 days of qualifying
catches: Points are Bass Pro/Cabela's store credit for merchandise - not cash; redeem via Pay with Points in the mobile app
Tiered: approval alone yields $20; the full $60 requires 7 qualifying purchases within 30 days
Credit approval required; application triggers a hard inquiry
Never spend extra just to chase the bonus - Other-purchases variable APR 19.49%-30.49% (as of 6/24/2026) wipes the bonus value if you carry a balance
Annual-fee net math: $0 annual fee, so any bonus kept is net of fees - as long as you pay in full
Pay the statement balance in full; the bonus is store credit, not cash
biggest_catch: The points are redeemable only for Bass Pro/Cabela's merchandise, not cash - and the full $60 needs 7 purchases in 30 days.
eligibility: Approved for the CLUB Mastercard; new cardholder
timing: Bonus points awarded within 60 days after qualifying; tiered purchases must be made within 30 days of approval.
